mike: Quick Q: our /v1/responses endpoint — how should clients treat fields declared as `nullable` in structured output when Content-Type is application/json vs application/ndjson? Are we returning null or omitting keys for empty values? Need compatibility guidance for mobile SDK.

sasha: Short answer: prefer omitting for older clients; we return `null` in JSON when explicitly set by model. For structured output we try to keep keys present if schema requires them. cc @elaine

elaine: To add: we have two modes. Hosted default returns keys with `null` for explicit nulls. Streaming NDJSON can emit missing fields per-chunk; clients should fallback on 'missing==null' semantics. We'll add note to API docs.

jordan: Is there an open PR for the SDK behavior change? Mobile clients currently crash on missing `metadata` object.

sasha: PR: https://git.internal/redwood/sdk/pulls/482 — it makes SDK treat undefined === null for required fields. Also adding `safeGet(obj, 'metadata') || {}`.

mike: Thanks. For JSON schema validation, do we enforce `required` in server-side validation or only as advisory? Example below: 
```json
{"type":"object","properties":{"label":{"type":"string"},"score":{"type":["number","null"]}},"required":["label"]}
``` 
If model returns no `label` do we reject?

elaine: We reject if `required` missing on the synchronous path. For streaming we accept and emit validation warnings in `meta.validation` but still stream tokens. We prefer fail-fast on sync to avoid downstream surprises.

infra-bot: deploy-bot: canary deploy to eng-platform at 03:20 UTC succeeded :deploy:

jordan: Edge case: older clients expect `content-type: application/json; charset=utf-8` exactly. We should keep that header stable. Any changes need deprecation announcement.

sasha: :thumbsup: I'll add a compatibility note and a short migration guide showing how to treat `null` vs missing. Also propose an API param `compat=legacy` to force legacy behavior for 30 days.

mike: If someone can add a tiny schema example to docs and a unit test that simulates mobile SDK missing-key crash that'd be great. I'll file tickets.

elaine: Filed: https://git.internal/redwood/issues/1221 — includes test and doc updates. Assigning to @sasha for docs, @jordan for SDK.
